method: label-blind ambient S2-to-smartphone AAC audio; 800–1800 Hz log-energy at 100 Hz; cross-correlation followed by local anchors
calibration_and_validation: alternating window indices; odd indices held out from offset estimation
uncertainty_bound: max(0.05 seconds, maximum accepted held-out residual + 0.02 seconds); empirical engineering bound, not a calibrated CI
support: union of accepted calibration and held-out windows; no extrapolation beyond supported audio regions
mapping: constant video_time = sensor_time + offset; do not force an affine warp
frame_guard: alignment uncertainty plus half a native frame; targets are 16 equal bin centers in the guarded interval; verify actual decoded PTS with full uncertainty against the original interval
visual_policy: review every proposed 16-frame contact sheet; require recognizable spindle/workpiece/cutting context; exclude fully obscured views; optical tool-defect visibility is a separate stricter claim
notes: Protocol was chosen during exploratory signal inspection without consulting anomaly classes. S2 resolves microphone mismatch seen with S0. It is not claimed to be externally preregistered.
